title: Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold8 sales jump over 20% in Korea after iPhone Duo launch
caption:
Samsung's Fold8 just saw a massive sales boost in Korea. While Apple's new foldable faced high prices and early hardware issues, the local favorite capitalized on the sudden interest in foldables.

Source: Koreaherald - Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold8 sales jump over 20% in Korea after iPhone Duo launch
